review:
A compact 3x3, nine-line game with wild multipliers and four jackpots. The 3x wild multiplies any win it's in (except jackpots), any wild on a winning line pays the Mini, and three matching wilds pay the Minor, Major or Grand – up to 500x.

A Bonus symbol on reel three gives 10 free spins, where a random 2x to 20x multiplier applies to every win – including jackpots. That's how 10,000x happens. 96.5% RTP. Retro layout, modern features.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
